notes:
Overview: Enterprise contact center for a payments + healthcare-billing provider. 8K agents, peak SMS/call spikes around billing cycles. Interested in agent-assist (real-time snippets), automatic ticket summarization, secure tool-calling (CRM/chargeback systems), and guaranteed behavior during seasonal spikes.

Security profile / ask: Must run within customer VPC (no outbound PHI/PCI to public internet). Require SSO (SAML), integration with existing KMS/HSM for key material, audit logs retained 7 years, detailed per-token audit granularity, and SOC2 + documented PCI scope reduction plan. Legal flagged PHI language in DPA — must be explicit about no model training/retention and ephemeral cache controls.

POC scope: 2-week agent-assist POC connecting to Zendesk + homegrown ticketing. Throughput target: baseline 120k tokens/day with 3x burst capacity; latency target 90th <= 350ms for quick-turn hints, tail <= 600ms. Must demo automatic fallback to a smaller model in case of capacity constraints and show cache hit improvements with prefix caching.

Technical preferences: Prefer Redwood Private in VPC; willing to evaluate Dedicated if Private control plane has gaps. Interested in quantization recommendations (to save cost) but cannot accept model variants that reduce auditability. Want explicit KV cache eviction controls and visibility.

Stakeholder quotes: "We cannot risk any PHI leaving our network, even for model telemetry." — Head of Security. "If we lose agent productivity during billing spikes we lose millions; reliability is non-negotiable." — Director, Contact Center Ops.

Risk appetite: Low for data exfiltration, medium for trade-offs on latency vs cost if we have guarantees and observability.

Docs referenced: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ + initial architecture diagram (drive link). Gmail trail with procurement and legal. Two fireflies recordings (initial discovery + security deep dive). Jira ticket for HSM integration opened for Redwood SEs.

CRM shorthand: POC started 2026-02-15, load test scheduled 2026-03-04, security follow-up 2026-03-09. Procurement expects SOW review week of 2026-03-22.
